organization.name: AegisLayer
organization.mission: Publish a public reference architecture for governed, accountable, and fail-closed AI-initiated action systems.
organization.scope: Conceptual reference architecture, governance documentation, diagrams, public research planning artifacts, synthetic datasets, static demonstrations, and a reference SDK.
limitations: Public materials are conceptual and educational.
No claim is made that the repository is a production control plane.
No claim is made of certification, benchmark leadership, or deployed customer telemetry.
No Space performs external execution, real policy enforcement, or secret-dependent runtime operations.
principles: Separate AI reasoning from execution authority.
Validate identity and authority before authorization.
Require accountable approval for high-impact actions.
Scope connector access through explicit capabilities.
Continuously verify runtime trust and fail closed on drift.

documentation.title: Reference Architecture Guide

documentation.title: Governance
documentation.summary: Governance responsibilities, approval expectations, and accountability framing.

documentation.title: Threat Control Traceability

architecture_layers.name: Identity and Authority
architecture_layers.purpose: Verify who is requesting an action and what explicit authority they hold.

architecture_layers.name: Policy Evaluation
architecture_layers.purpose: Evaluate policy before execution and branch into deny, allow, conditional, or approval-required states.

architecture_layers.name: Human Approval
architecture_layers.purpose: Bind high-impact actions to accountable human decisions with scope and expiry.

architecture_layers.name: Connector Trust
architecture_layers.purpose: Constrain execution to explicit capabilities and readiness-gated connectors.

architecture_layers.name: Runtime and Evidence
architecture_layers.purpose: Track runtime state, produce evidence, and preserve auditability.

architecture_layers.name: Continuous Verification
architecture_layers.purpose: Re-evaluate trust during runtime and revoke on drift or anomaly.

architecture_layers.name: Containment and Recovery
architecture_layers.purpose: Fail closed, contain incidents, and require explicit recovery decisions.

trust_boundaries.name: Reasoning to Authority Boundary
trust_boundaries.summary: A model may propose an action, but authority remains outside the model and must be validated.

trust_boundaries.name: Policy to Execution Boundary
trust_boundaries.summary: Execution proceeds only after policy resolves the request into an explicit permitted state.

trust_boundaries.name: Connector to Runtime Boundary
trust_boundaries.summary: Connectors expose narrow capability scopes and fail closed when readiness degrades.

trust_boundaries.name: Runtime to Evidence Boundary
trust_boundaries.summary: Every material decision and state transition produces reviewable evidence.
